mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO agent_result_operation (tenant_id, operation_id, type, host_name, mac_address, status, request_json, result_json, raw_message, created_at, finished_at, received_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{tenantId}, 0), #{operationId}, #{type}, #{hostName}, #{macAddress}, #{status}, #{requestJson}, #{resultJson}, #{rawMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{finishedAt}, COALESCE(#{receivedAt}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, operation_id, type, host_name, mac_address, status, request_json, result_json, raw_message, created_at, finished_at, received_at FROM agent_result_operation WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} LIMIT 1
